notes.title: Role of Hex update 1.4.1
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.4.1 - 15/03/2024[/h1]
[h2]Verde's Notes[/h2][list]
	Hey people, it has been a while!
	
	I have been playing this game for a while now and I've saw some issues, so I got to fixing them. For this update specifically, I've set a rule for myself: "No new content, thats for 1.5!". Well, I've bent that rule as much as I could to introduce some things that I really thought the game was needing. Have fun!
[/list]
[h2]Big Changes[/h2][list]
	[*][h3]Experience System reworked[/h3][list]
		[*] Level is no longer capped at ~1600 due to floating point arithmetic
		[*] Experience multipliers now apply to everything, including now passive experience and experience from supply drop.
		[*] Several upgrades related to experience were modified, see more in balance changes.
	[/list]
	[*][h3]Lair Sealing[/h3][list]
		[*] It is now possible to seal boss lairs, so that they won't spawn bosses anymore.
		[*] When sealing the lair, several buildings will be built around the lair, if they're destroyed the seal will be broken.
		[*] It takes 15 seconds to seal the lair for the first time, a time which increases with every breach
		[*] You can always break the seal with a Nuke or Armageddon strike.
	[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Additions[/h2][list]
	[*] Added a small surprise for those who value drift a lot
	[*] Added an equipment that lets you ban upgrades
[/list]

[h2]Reworks[/h2][list]
	[*] Machine Learning[list]
		[*] Now applies to all sources of damage, including active abilities
		[*] Now a yellow upgrade
		[*] Scaling increased from 0.25% to 1%
	[/list]
	[*] Death Mark[list]
		[*] Now has a base damage and a percentage from current HP damage
		[*] No longer has diminishing damage, instead, has a fixed duration
		[*] No longer stacks
		[*] Now affects bosses
	[/list]
	[*] Death Spark[list]
		[*] Greatly simplified
		[*] Now when a kill happens, it recharges barreirs in radius
	[/list]
	[*] Pandora's Box[list]
		[*] All existing attack patterns rewritten
		[*] Now has 11 attack patterns
		[*] Starts with 3 attack patterns unlocked, unlocks more powerful ones after getting more of the upgrade
	[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list]
	[*] Deep analysis scaling heavily reduced
	[*] Supply drop experience is always a certain percentage of your current level
	[*] Productivity Modules now slightly increases how much EXP is needed to level up
	[*] Heavily increased how many enemies are needed for extermination missions
	[*] Money acquired by forfeiting upgrades is no longer tied directly to the exp needed to level up
	[*] Number of rerolls granted by reroll equipment reduced. Reroll charges slowly replenish based on your level.
	[*] Greatly reduced how many lava balls are needed to drain lava oceans
	[*] Greatly reduced wyvern's HP and damage
	[*] Increased overall enemy level, their HP and damage was downscalled to remain the same
	[*] Added caps to the following upgrades, since they were known for creating issues at higher numbers:[list]
		[*]Extended territory
		[*]Bullet Buffer
		[*]Overclock
		[*]Armageddon
	[/list]
	[*] Special Upgrade "Slow but Steady" now only applies attack speed multiplier as damage to buildings, level based damage multiplier is still aplied to every source
	[*] Reduced how much bigger explosived and primed shot increases your AoEs
[/list]

[h2]QoL Changes[/h2][list]
	[*] In-world upgrade notifications now have a cooldown
	[*] In-world upgrade notifications now don't show up if they aren't within view
	[*] Value Drift and Nuke animations are no longer tied to game time, this should make it still while the game is paused and/or menus are open
	[*] Value Drift animations are shorter, to compensate for the fact that the speed menu doesn't work on them anymore
	[*] Value Drift animations get 20% shorter with every value drift
	[*] Hex shards now still render in the map view
	[*] Hex shards grow with zoom out so that they are easier to spot
	[*] Boss lair will no longer attempt to spawn a boss if a boss is alive or a hex shard is on the map
	[*] It is no longer possible to build within a boss lair
	[*] Boss lair fissures are now always visible through the ocean, regardless of view mode
	[*] Special upgrade selections such as ability replacement and clone factories will now have a slightly different background
	[*] When attempting to build, there is now a message on failure containing details of why it failed
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
	[*] Fixed Earthquake tower's attack being invisible
	[*] Fixed Earthquake tower's visual being weird when the player has bullet buffer
	[*] Fixed Frenzy's damage increase being 10 times stronger than the tooltip suggested
	[*] Fixed hex shard on top of nuclear crater not being clickable
	[*] Fixed selected active ability going on cooldown when another active ability gets autocasted
	[*] Fixed some active abilities being autocast on mouse position when there are no enemies around
	[*] Fixed multitile buildings not properly updating buildings around them
	[*] Fixed multitile buildings destroying themselves on update
	[*] Fixed multitile buildings not updating their visuals fluidly
	[*] Fixed failing to build halting all your building capabilities for 2 seconds
	[*] Fixed prodmod and charged trigger being always available despite them having clear unlock conditions
	[*] Fix bug where regions of yunuus would not render properly
[/list]

[h2]Optimizations[/h2][list]
	[*] HEAVILY improved unusual lubricant for active abilities with big radius.
	[*] Changed the code for checking AoE, should speed up drastically every AoE bigger than 1 tile
	[*] Reduced the drawing time of map objects in regular view
	[*] Added several visual-only objects to the particle cap
[/list]

notes.title: Role of Hex - Lightning Round Update
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.4.0 - 08/03/2024 - Lightning Round[/h1]
[h2]Additions[/h2][list]
	[h3]Time Controls[/h3][list]
		[*]Allows speeding up the game by 2x, 3x or 4x.
		[*]Disabled when too many structures are damaged or when a lag report is generated
	[/list]
	[h3]Challenges[/h3][list]
		[*]7 Challenges under the new Simulations Mission tab.
		[*]Each challenge unlocks an upgrade with their theme once they are completed.
	[/list]
	[h3]Build Saving[/h3][list]
		[*]You can now save your auto upgrade priorities with ctrl+number, then load it by pressing that number
	[/list]
	[h3]Upgrades[/h3][list]
		Purple Upgrades:
		[*]Static: Projectiles create lightning on impact.
		
		7 Challenge-related upgrades
	[/list]
	[h3]Specializations[/h3][list]
		2 new specs, one for minefield deployer and one for tesla tower
	[/list]
	[h3]Equipment[/h3][list]
		[*]Tesla Tower: Allows you to build tesla towers and gives access to their specialization
		[*]Random Blueprint: Transforms itself into a random tower blueprint when a mission starts
	[/list]
	[h3]New Enemies[/h3][list]
		[h3]Ice Ball[/h3][list]
			[*]Has a ranged attack
			[*]Slows
			[*]Attacks multiple buildings at once
		[/list]
		[h3]Wyvern[/h3][list]
			[*]Attacks by sweeping over your buildings
		[/list]
	[/list]
	[h3]Resource Blobs[/h3][list]
		[*]Experience and Resources now spawn as small blobs that are absorbed by buildings
	[/list]
	[h3]Run Rebooting[/h3][list]
		[*]The game will now try to reboot your run at your last value drift if something crashes it.
	[/list]
	[h3]Buff and Debuff system for buildings[/h3][list]
		[*]Includes new buffs and debuffs such as "Slowness", "Shielding" and "Multishot"
	[/list]
[/list]


[h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list]
	[*]New Tower unlocks now happen every 15 difficulty instead of 20
	[*]Building near lava now aggro it after 2-4 seconds
	[*]Ocean is no longer a suitable biome for spawning
	
	[h3]Tower Changes[/h3][list]
		[h3]Behemoth[/h3][list]
			[*]Damage decreased from 20 to 15
			[*]Attack speed reduced from 0.16 to 0.1
			[*]Accuracy reduced from 1 to 0.33
		[/list]
		[h3]Machine Gun[/h3][list]
			[*]Damage increased from 0.5 to 1
			[*]Base attack speed increased from 1.5 to 2
			[*]Attack speed bonus from firing increased from up to 3x to 5x
			[*]Now properly lose their attack speed bonus from firing when idle
		[/list]
		[h3]Earthquake Generator[/h3][list]
			[*]Shooting cooldown reduced from 10 seconds to 5 seconds
			[*]Range increased from 0.5 to 0.75
		[/list]
		[h3]Sniper[/h3][list]
			[*]Range increased from 1.6 to 2
		[/list]
		[h3]High-Density Spheres[/h3][list]
			[*]Doubled knockback chance
		[/list]
	[/list]
	
	[h3]Upgrade Changes[/h3][list]
		[h3]Machine Learning[/h3][list]
			[*]Scaling reduced from 1% to 0.25%
			[*]Scales based on kills from every building of the same type
			[*]Keeps values on value drifts
			[*]Combined towers count as "Structure" building type
		[/list]
		[h3]Frenzy[/h3][list]
			[*]Duration increased from 2s to 5s
		[/list]
		[h3]Smite[/h3][list]
			[*]Damage increased from 1% to 5%
			[*]Radius heavily reduced
			[*]Now bounces 10 times per second instead of instantly and can bounce outside the initial radius, this applies to every source of lightning damage within the game
		[/list]
		[h3]Frenzy Surge[/h3][list]
			[*]Cooldown increased from 30s to 60s
			[*]Is now global
			[*]Now has an animation
		[/list]
		[h3]Scan[/h3][list]
			[*]Now has an animation
		[/list]
		[h3]Cryogenic Technology[/h3][list]
			[*]Longer chance based
			[*]Can now apply multiple stacks per hit and even applies non-integer number of stacks
			[*]Now affects bosses, although it doesn't slow them.
		[/list]
		[h3]Frostbite[/h3][list]
			[*]Now scales in hits per second instead of dps only
			[*]Can hit on uneven tick intervals and even multiple times per tick
			[*]Can still trigger every on-hit effect
		[/list]
		[h3]Growth[/h3][list]
			[*]Can happen on uneven tick intervals and even multiple times per tick
		[/list]
	[/list]
	
	[h3]Specs[/h3][list]
		Many of these now scale with player-level
		[h3]Primed Shot[/h3][list]
			[*]Chance is now fixed at 25%
			[*]Damage and radius increase changed from 100% to level*4
		[/list]
		[h3]Ignite[/h3][list]
			[*]Damage changed from 40% to level%
		[/list]
		[h3]Slow But Steady[/h3][list]
			[*]Damage increase changed from 100% to level
		[/list]
		[h3]Barrage[/h3][list]
			[*]Attack speed increase changed from 100% to level
		[/list]
		[h3]WeakSpot Detector[/h3][list]
			[*]Damage increase changed from 400% to level*20%
		[/list]
		[h3]Synthetic Aperture[/h3][list]
			[*]You now keep the benefits of telescopes when you value drift
		[/list]
		[h3]Unusual Lubricant[/h3][list]
			[*]Can no longer target enemies in the fog of war
		[/list]
	[/list]
	
	[h3]Enemy Changes[/h3][list]
		[h3]Shark[/h3][list]
			[*]No longer swims through land
		[/list]
		[h3]Ice Shards[/h3][list]
			[*]No longer spawn within a radius of 6 blocks of the spawning position
			[*]No longer show up on the map view
			[*]Shoots shards on destruction that slow towers for 15 seconds
		[/list]
		[h3]Fire Bat[/h3][list]
			[*]Fire now ticks twice per second instead of just once, total damage is unchanged
		[/list]
		[h3]Sulfuric Geyser[/h3][list]
			[*]Can now be killed
		[/list]
		[h3]Snowballs[/h3][list]
			[*]Drastically reduced growth cap
			[*]When hitting the growth cap, it will break into 2 smaller snowballs, with growth reset
		[/list]
	[/list]
[/list]

[h2]General Changes[/h2][list]
	[*]Changed the behavior of replacing your active skill to something more intuitive
	[*]Made it so that seeing the enemy is enough to unlock its database entry
	[*]Colonies now show their checking area when hovered with alt
	[*]The relationship between hotkeys and equipment slots is now consistent
	[*]Mission selection drop list now also shows upgrades available conditionally
	[*]Made some changes to the lag compensation so that the game feels more responsive at lower tps
[/list]

[h2]Visual Changes[/h2][list]
	[*]Made earth fissures emerging from the boss lair denser and with more branches
	[*]Menu should be more widescreen friendly with virtual black bars
	[*]Added icons for all Kokatune biomes
	[*]When starting a mission or on value drift, the name of the planet is now shown
	[*]Rewritten lag reports so that they are more readable
	[*]Action icons when selecting a building are now a bit smaller than one tile, so that you can select the adjacent tile without clicking on it
	[*]Added indicators to when upgrades trigger, both in the map and on the left side of the UI
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
	[*]Fixed "Invalid key to next" error screen
	[*]Fixed gathering missions not showing on Kokatune
	[*]Fixed a crash with some flamethrower merges
	[*]Potential drops are now correctly positioned on the mission screen
	[*]Fixed nuke auto-casting at mouse position when there are no enemies
	[*]Notification camera movement should be a lot more reliable now
[/list]

notes.title: Role of Hex update 1.3.1
notes.content:
Hey people, now that the winter sale has cooled down a bit and I got I break to work on late-game stuff again, here is a balance patch specifically focused on the late game (>50% equipment completion)

There is a big focus here on allowing the player to make multiple value drifts, as well as making it possible to transition to a more defensive-oriented strategy as enemies become stronger in later drifts

The next big update will probably be focused on general content like new upgrades, new equipment, and more enemies. With few changes to the gameplay loop itself other than allowing several different builds to flourish. Keep an eye on our discord for more information about these, since I will probably be posting several details about the development process there

Anyway, here are the patch notes:

[h2]Removals[/h2][list]
	[*]Temporarily removed static purple upgrade, will be reworked and reintroduced, it was a significant cause of lag in its current iteration
[/list] 
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list]
	[*]Increased range gains from telescopes
	[*]Greatly reduced value drift increase on difficulty
	[*]Increased drop chances for yellow and purple equipment
	[*]Reduced minimum boss lair dormant time to 2.5 minutes
	[*]Reduced average distance of boss lair to starting position, this distance now reduces for every value drift
	[*]Reduced how much projectile speed affected things that aren't regular projectiles, such as missiles and earthquakes
	[*]Boss Lairs can no longer spawn on the other side of a regular ocean
	[*] The game now spawns a hex shard if it can't place a boss lair in any suitable location
	[*]Sulfuric bursts from both yellow balls and sulfuric geysers now deal massively reduced damage to shielded buildings
	[*]You can now toggle auto-cast on specific active skills rather than only turning off auto-cast as a whole
	[*]Hex shard now reveals a small area around it when it spawns
[/list]
[h2]Visual Changes[/h2][list]
	[*]Bosses now are shown normally on the map view
	[*]Earth fissures caused by King Lurker and earthquake towers had their z-index fixed
	[*]Camera movement speed when notification is clicked significantly increased
	[*]If you move your camera while the camera is being dragged by a notification, the drag ends
[/list]
[h2]Framework Changes[/h2][list]
	[*]Updated Love2d from 11.3 to 11.5
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.0e
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Verde here.
First of all, I would like to thank you for the massive wave of feedback I'm getting from the last update.

I'm here to make myself a little bit more transparent about what issues I'm working on right now, what is being fixed, and what has been fixed.

My current focus for the next hotfixes is the following:[list]
[*]Fixing the overwhelming strength(not number) of enemies that come around 5-minute marks: 5:00; 10:00; and 15:00.. there currently is a cascading effect when you cannot kill the first ones as soon as possible, making the next ones even stronger.
[*]Making time spent on a run also count towards drops. Currently, drops are calculated only around mission progress, meaning that if you make 0 progress in a 30-minute run, you get no rewards, and that needs to be changed.
[*] Make sure that the game communicates how you are expected to do certain things, like farming a great number of drops or killing certain enemies that have no obvious spawning conditions
[/list]

Also, I've introduced a loading screen in the hotfix 1.3.0e so that some computers, especially higher-end ones, wouldn't get race conditions when trying to launch the game, resulting in a white screen. I don't have data on whether that fixed the issue for everyone, if anyone is having any issue with opening the game please tell me ASAP so I can fix it for you and for everyone else who is also experiencing the same issue as you.

Also, don't be afraid of commenting on some issue that you are having in either the Steam community or our discord server, be it balance, visuals, or crashes. I am a single human being and I can't find all issues around the game so your support is of immense value both for me and for the game.

Anyway, back to work, see you later with 1.3.0f

notes.title: Role of Hex - Value Drift Update
notes.content:
[h1]Role of Hex Version 1.3[/h1]

[h2]Additions[/h2][list]
	[h3]Tech Tree[/h3][list]
		A new tech tree replaces the equipment screen.
		Now every equipment is active at all times, except for blueprints, for which you can still only select 3
		Equipment now drops during a mission instead of at the end of it, so that if you lose or close the game during a mission, you still get some drops
		Most equipment are now more limited in terms of where you can find them
		Increased max levels of every equipment from 5/10/15 to 6/12/18
	[/list]
	[h3]Boss System Overhaul[/h3][list]
		Bosses no longer spawn naturally
		Instead, they now live in their lair, it is your task to find them
		They now also drop Hex Shards, which can be used to obtain unmeasurable power
	[/list]
	[h3]Tower Merging[/h3][list]
		Once certain conditions are met, you can merge 7 of your offensive towers into a big one, inheriting the properties of the two that most repeat within the group.
		There are 36 combinations and they are all unique!
	[/list]
	[h3]New Equipment[/h3][list]
		Build speed, turn speed, AoE increase, cooldown reduction, projectile speed and building price reduction
	[/list]
	[h3]3 New Upgrades[/h3][list]
		Cheaper Structures[list]
			Reduces prices
		[/list]
		Deeper Analysis[list]
			Increases experience gains
		[/list]
		Production line[list]
			Gives resources every second
		[/list]
	[/list]
	[h3]New Towers[/h3][list]
		Minefield deployer[list]
			Places mines around that explode on contact
			Deployment speed scales with build speed
		[/list]
	[/list]
	[h3]In game patch notes[/h3][list]
		You can find this list on the game itself too!
	[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list]
	[*]Frenzy Surge no longer has its duration added to its cooldown
	[*]Tombstone now creates deactivated buildings instead of fully active ones
	[*]Reduced some values on some economic equipment
	[*]Changed enemy spawn cycles to be a tad bit more aggressive
	[*]Bosses will no longer spawn naturally, requiring interaction with the new "Boss Lair" structure that spawns on the map
	[*]Reduced base stats for cannons and economy due to new equipment system
	[*]Reduced the amount of salvageable ruins in a 30-hex radius around the spawning area
	[*]Sulfuric Geysers should no longer spawn within a 15-hex radius of the spawning area
	[*]Enemies now despawn if they are too far away from your base
	[*]Upgrades and equipment that increase upgrade options now only affect maximum options
	[*]Heavily increased supply drop's resource gain
[/list]

[h2]General Changes[/h2][list]
	[*]Notifications now move your camera smoothly when clicked instead of teleporting you there
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
	[*]Fixed bullet buffer generating ghost shots
	[*]Fixed data centers not working under certain conditions
	[*]Fixed several holes in King Lurker's hug attack hitbox
[/list]

notes.title: Role of Hex 1.2
notes.content:
This time I tried to focus a bit more on balance and content rather than optimizations. Of course, I've optimized the two greater issues that I've found within the game during that time, but most of my time these last two weeks was spent on new stuff.

Changes with ⬡ icon were suggested by the community.

[h2]Additions[/h2][list]
	[h3]New Planet: Kokatune[/h3][list]
		A fiery planet with nasty foes
		Difficulty level from 65-128
	[/list]
	[h3]New Biome: Ash Basin[/h3][list]
		Full of dunes, the most peaceful biome of Kokatune
	[/list]
	[h3]New Biome: Basalt Delta[/h3][list]
		Has several magma lakes which can come to life to hurt your base.
	[/list]
	[h3]New Biome: Sulfuric Wasteland[/h3][list]
		Hosts several sulfuric geysers which often erupt, damaging nearby structures
	[/list]
	[h3]New Biome: Lava Ocean[/h3][list]
		A regular ocean, but made out of a different liquid
	[/list]
	[h3]New Enemy: King Lurker[/h3][list]
		The first boss of the game has multiple attack patterns and can be found everywhere.
		Bosses will now spawn every 20 minutes on every mission.
		Regular enemy spawns halt while there is a boss alive
	[/list]
	[h3]New Enemies[/h3][list]
		Every biome from Kokatune features at least one new enemy for you to play with.
	[/list]
	[h3]New Objectives[/h3][list]
		Added 3 new objectives: Defend, Colonize, and Eliminate.
		Some missions on some planets can only be of certain types.
	[/list]
	[h3]New player towers[/h3][list]
		2 blueprints for new towers added
		They can be found on missions with difficulty ranging from 101 to 128
	[/list]
	[h3]New Specializations[/h3][list]
		Added 2 new specializations for the two new player-buildable towers
	[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list]
	[h3]Clone Factory[/h3][list]
		Reduced Rarity factor from 5 to 1
		This means that the rarity of the upgrade selected is similar to level 1 rather than level 5
	[/list]
	[h3]Frenzy[/h3][list]
		Stacks no longer increase duration, duration is now fixed at 2 seconds
		Stacks now increase the attack speed multiplier, which starts at 1.2 and grows by 0.2 for every stack
	[/list]
	[h3]Frenzy Surge[/h3][list]
		Now only drops if the player has at least one stack of Frenzy
	[/list]
	[h3]Frostbite[/h3][list]
		Rarity increased from Yellow to Purple
		Base damage increased from 5 to [cannon damage]/2
		Its damage instances can now proc on-damage effects, such as Cryotech
	[/list]
	[h3]King of the hill[/h3][list]
		Now actually stacks
		Values reduced from 25% to 10%
	[/list]
	[h3]Airborne Static[/h3][list]
		Rarity increased from Yellow to Purple
		Radius increased from (2.0 + 0.2*stack) to (2.0 + 0.5*stack) 
		The barrier to damage multiplier increased from (0.3+0.2*stack) to (0.5*stack)
	[/list]
	[h3]Overclock[/h3][list]
		Rarity increased from Yellow to Purple
		Cooldown reduction increased from 25% to 33%
	[/list]
	[h3]Bigger Explosives[/h3][list]
		Rarity increased from Yellow to Purple
		Now scales linearly
		Damage scaling increased from 30% to 100%
	[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life changes[/h2][list]
	[h3]Changed Lag Reports[/h3][list]
		Now contains the current version
		Now contains the current building counts
		Now contains the current upgrades counts
	[/list]
	[h3]Pause changes[/h3][list]
		⬡ You can now press spacebar to toggle pause
		Pause can now be toggled within the upgrade selection menu
	[/list]
	[h3]Building Recycling Rework[/h3][list]
		When you press "F" to recycle a building, it is now scheduled for recycling.
		You can undo the scheduling by pressing "ctrl+F".
		It will recycle in the first tick where it is able to.

notes.title: Role of Hex - Update is coming, Early Access end is nigh.
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it has been a while.

Contrary to what many might believe, I did not become a tree, but I reckon communication wasn't that frequent in this meantime.

With the last update, I noticed several limitations of the game I was working on and had to do something to fix it. The solution I found required me to rewrite most of it, so that is what I've been doing for the past few months. 

This announcement, however, is here to bring some good news: The rewrite is almost done, and it brings some interesting features to the table of possibilities, as well as some redesign of some very old pieces of the game that remained untouched for a very long time.

Some features that this update will be able to include due to this rewrite are being able to save your run to continue it later, as well as smooth slow motion and a very noticeable performance increase.

As for a date, I am currently aiming toward releasing it mid to late June, but there is a public Trello documenting my progress through it, you can find it [url=https://trello.com/b/bL9JZEw6/role-of-hex]here.[/url] I'm also always active on our [url=https://discord.gg/NRc6MkU]Discord server[/url], so you can ask me any questions there or in our community hub.

Regarding Early Access, some of you might notice that we are a few months past the date that was originally set for the full release, don't worry as this will be the last update of the early access period, we will soon be transitioning out of it.

It has been a wonderful journey and the game will still get updates after its full release. Those updates will come at a public and regular schedule once the time arrives and will be focusing mostly on content and out-of-game progression.

notes.title: Role of Hex - Endless Combinations Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Content[/h1][list]
[*][h3]New Enemy Spawn System[/h3][list]

[*]Once a new variant is detected, the narrator will announce its presence if it spawns outside of your camera vision
[/list]

[*][h3]Synergies[/h3][list]
[*]When two special buildings are placed adjacent to each other, they have a chance of triggering a synergy when they fire.
[*]About 50% of the possible combinations are valid synergies, have fun finding them all, some are quite strong, some not that much, but every synergy is an upgrade from the original building.
[/list]

[*][h3]Steam Achievements[/h3][list]
[*]Now every unlock in the game has its respective steam achievement.
[*]If you had some unlocks before this patch, getting any new unlock or finishing a run should update it.
[/list]

[*][h3][b]New Unlocks:[/b][/h3][list]

[*][b]Aggressive Mob[/b][list]
[*]Have 120 enemies alive at the same time
[*]Unlocks Unusual Lubricant Upgrade[/list]

[*][b]Build them all[/b][list]
[*]Unlock 8 different special buildings
[*]Unlocks Minefield Deployer Special Building[/list]

[*][b]I'm in Danger[/b][list]
[*]Survive 1 minute with temporary difficulty on
[*]Unlocks Supply Drop Active Skill[/list]
[/list]

[*][h3]Minefield Deployer Special Building[/h3][list]
[*]Unlocked by "Build Them all"
[*]Fills its range with mines, causing damage when enemies come close to them
[/list]

[*][h3]Unusual Lubricant Upgrade[/h3][list]
[*]Unlocked by "Aggressive Mob"
[*]Purple Tier upgrade
[*]Whenever an enemy is killed, reduce all your active skills cooldowns by 1 second each
[/list]

[*][h3]Supply Drop Active Skill[/h3][list]
[*]Unlocked by "I'm in Danger"
[*]Yellow Tier Active Skill
[*]When activated, spawns 1 upgrade drop in the selected location
[*]Further stacks increases the average rarity of the drop
[*]Cooldown: 90 seconds
[/list]

[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1][list]
[*][h3]Temporary Difficulty[/h3][list]
[*]When a building of yours is broken as well as when several other triggers happen, the game enters a mode called "Temporary Difficulty", shown by orangeish/red borders on the screen
[*]While the temporary difficulty is on, the difficulty is increased and enemies spawn more frequently.
[/list]

[*][h3]Drop Changes[/h3][list]
[*]Now every drop from the same spiral will have the same rarity.
[/list]

[*][h3]Tree Changes[/h3][list]
[*]Trees are now always vulnerable, but they are not targeted by your buildings by default
[*]When destroyed, they increase the temporary difficulty
[*]Their visual was completely redone, should fit a little bit more with the thematic of the game
[/list]

[*][h3]Laser Cannon Special Building[/h3][list]
[*]Now increases the damage its target takes from all sources until it dies
[*]The effect stacks with itself and can lead to monstrous damage numbers
[*]This effect applies to its synergies as well
[/list]

[*][h3]Tesla Tower Special Building[/h3][list]
[*]Reduced damage from 100% of its shield to 50%
[*]Reduced self-damage from 50% of its shield to 25%
[/list]

[*][h3]Nuke Active Skill[/h3][list]
[*]Unbuildable area is now temporary and deals damage over time to enemies that walk over it
[*]AoE is much bigger than it was, but full damage AoE remains the same.
[*]The crater now has new graphics and a tooltip with how much time it will remain unbuildable
[/list]

[*][h3]Organic Growth Upgrade[/h3][list]
[*]Now prioritizes building adjacent to non-organic buildings
[/list]

[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[list]
[*][h3]World Map:[/h3][list]
[*]Now when you hold TAB, you can see a quick drawing of the entire map
[*]By right-clicking into the said map, you can move your camera there.
[/list]

[*][h3]Initial Pause[/h3][list]
[*]Game will now start paused and will unpause when the player does any significant action
[*]There is a sound indicator to tell the player that the clock is now running
[/list]

[*][h3]UI Changes:[/h3][list]
[*]Basic tile and analyse are now included in the bottom-right part of the UI
[*]The current prices for every building are now also included in the bottom-right part, rather than in the top-right
[*]When holding alt, a map of the possible blueprint locations is also shown, the next blueprint is guaranteed to be in one of the 10 cells highlighted
[/list]

[*][h3]Camera Movement Options[/h3][list]
[*]You can now also move the camera using arrow keys and +/-, this is especially helpful when the player is using a laptop
[/list]

[/list]

[h1]"Removed" Content[/h1]
In this patch, some enemies were temporarily removed from the game due to design flaws within their concepts. Some of them should return once I am able to fix every underlying problem with them.
[list]
[*][h3]Mobile Wasphouse[/h3][list]
[*]This one was the most problematic enemy in the game in a sense of performance, since it wasn't a boss, several of them could spawn at the same time, each of them spawning dozens of wasps over their lifetime.
[*]I plan on reintroducing the Mobile Wasphouse as a boss on the next update, I will have to rework it to have more interesting attack patterns since it will take most of your attention once one spawns.
[/list]
[*][h3]Sandworms[/h3][list]
[*]This one was the second on this list because of how unfair they feel when playing against them, often they took several buildings even after being killed and there was not much the player could do to fight back.
[*]I plan on reintroducing the Sandworms but completely reworking them in the process, the invulnerability aspect of them will be probably limited to a variant at most.
[/list]
[*][h3]King Lurker[/h3][list]
[*]The King Lurkers themselves had no design issue but were temporarily removed just due to the lack of a proper boss mechanic within the game.
[*]I plan on introducing a boss system where the player has some agency about when to spawn a boss, as it will be part of the steps necessary in order to properly finish a run
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
This section is heavily technical, but Verde tries to explain what should be the impact on the game
[list]
[*][h3]Object Pooling:[/h3][list]
[*]An attempt to minimize the time that the garbage collector spends running
[*]This should reduce the frequency and intensity of the lag spikes within the game
[/list]

[*][h3]Streamlined Sound Source Management:[/h3][list]
[*]Now sources should be recycled as often as possible to ensure minimal memory usage
[*]This should reduce how much RAM the game uses in the later stages of a run
[*]This should also reduce the frequency of the silent crashes since they were usually related to LuaJIT's 2GB ram limit
[/list]

[/list]

[h1]Verde's Comments[/h1]
In this update, the game became significantly more difficult, I am aware of that and I plan on lowering that difficulty as I further update the game, But I noticed that for now, the difficulty is kind of necessary in order to give objective to the player.
Feel free to ask in the steam community or in our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/NRc6MkU]here[/url] if there is anything you feel unsure about.

[*]Has a massive AoE

notes.title: Weekly Update 3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Verde is back with another weekly update!
In this update Verde was a bit all over the place, fixing bugs, implementing a new upgrade, making some changes to the difficulty and of course, trying his best to make sure that those FPS are not running away when the big monsters come by.

Without further redo, let's get started:

[h2]New Upgrade[strike]s[/strike]![/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Postmortem Static[/h3]
Purple upgrade. 
Makes dead enemies zap alive enemies for damage based on your shield upgrades
[/list]

[list]
[*]Getting your buildings destroyed will no longer increase difficulty, instead, it will accelerate the spawn cycle a little bit (1 second every 60 difficulty levels) with no long-term penalty.

notes.title: Weekly content update the first
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is Verde and today we're are releasing the game's first content update,
Sadly, due to health problems, this update will be significantly smaller than the next ones.
The plan is to release these updates weekly, so keep an eye on them.

But Verde, what have actually changed?

Well, let's get started then.

To get things started, the overall building and upgrade cost was changed to now account for the number of buildings currently in the game, this way, there should be more comeback potential within the game. Suggestion by blariviere, from our discord server.

As straight-up new things: a new point of interest was added in the desert, a mine. This one will generate gold over time, based on your current income! Suggestion from a nice user in our steam reviews.

Several upgrades got tweaked somehow, here is the list:
[list]
[*][b]Out With A Bang[/b]: Buildings that haven't been fully constructed won't blow anymore, damage increased from 1000% turret damage to 1000% turret damage + 10% building health
[*][b]Higher Calliber[/b]: Damage up from 50% to 100%, attack speed down from 25% to 33%
[*][b]Nuke[/b]: Damage down from infinity to 10000% turret damage, won't destroy invulnerable structures(such as upgrades) anymore.
[/list]

This is the first of many content updates that are planned to be released from the game, much of them are only possible because of your feedback, so I'm here to thank you.

One last thing, I also plan on releasing a roadmap soon(ish) here in the events, I won't specifically discuss what I plan on releasing into each update, but I want to at least keep you informed about the size and frequency of updates, so you can know when to expect changes.

notes.title: Hotfix the fourth
notes.content:
Starting with the gameplay changes:
[list]
[*]Disconnected buildings no longer take damage, instead, they stop working until they are connected again. Suggestion by Marian from our [url=https://discord.gg/NRc6MkU]discord server[/url].
[*]Increased the game difficulty a little bit, reason explained in the bugfixes.
[/list]
And that's it. More gameplay changes and content is planned for Wednesday's update, but today, we're focusing on bugs and performance.

And speaking of bugs:
[list]
[*]Quickbuild can no longer build over unbuildable/unrevealed terrain.
[*]Structures are now properly shown in screenshot mode (F2).
[*]Structures can no longer be destroyed multiple times. This was affecting both difficulty and on-death effects like "Out With a Bang". This is mostly the reason why I had to tweak difficulty, as it was causing difficulty to go up unnaturally and removing it reversed the effect.
[/list]

For performance, we have:
[list]
[*]Reduced the number of rocks a building generates when hit and destroyed.
[*]Changed the main loop so it will no longer catch itself in a positive-feedback loop when tick times are too high. Now throws a "Can't keep up" and skips a few ticks when it has troubles.
[*]Switched optimization profiler(this will not have any imediate impact on the game, but will probably lead to further optimizations down the road)
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix the third
notes.content:
First, let's start with gameplay affecting bugs: 
Flamethrower and Nuke are no longer obtainable via Clone Factory
It is no longer needed to build in an unbuildable biome in order to obtain the "Explorer" unlock.

Now that those are out of the way, Verde also added some icons to structures that aren't yet built, so you can know what will be there soon.

Some performance improvements were made to the game, they should become more noticeable at around the 25-minute mark.

Fixed a rare bug that would make the game crash when going to the main menu. Thanks to Marian from our discord server for finding that one.

At last, but not least, Verde found and fixed a bug that was causing the game to crash when a boss would attempt to spawn with more than 100 enemies on the screen, that bug is no more.

notes.title: Hotfix Number 2
notes.content:
Verde was happy, playing his video game, 25 minutes in and some King Lurkers spawn. Nothing new, Verde thought, unaware of the weapon these creatures had prepared for him. When everything was going well and the bosses were at low HP, one of them unleashed its hidden power: crashing the game, the one thing that Verde's defences could not protect him against.
Verde then fixed it with the anger of a thousand red pixels, King Lurkers will crash the game no more.

As per usual, people from the discord server helped Verde in his fight, giving him powerful insight into features that would make the game better: There is now a "quick-build" option in the configs. Enabling it will allow hexagons to be built with never seen agility using "A", "S" and "D" as hotkeys based only on the position of the mouse. We thank Marian for this wonderful suggestion.

Some other bugs were found and fixed, those being:
Wild buildings were triggering unlocks as soon as the game would launch.
Creatures would drop upgrades in the menu screen, eventually cluttering it.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Verde was wondering why his game was running so slow in the later stages, so Verde came to the rescue.

Turns out there was a bug making the game render stuff that was outside the screen, that bug was fixed.

Aside from that, Wild Buildings now have an icon that shows what they are about when found. That should add glance value, Verde decided.

Another change is that upgrades are now dropped by creatures in general based on the current difficulty instead of being dictated by the creature's type. The drops are no longer dictated by the creature's type.
This should make the early game more bearable without changing the difficulty that much in later stages.

While Verde was implementing those changes, Verde got a suggestion from a nice user in our discord server and now there are hotkeys in the game for buildings and upgrades!
